title: History of Posterstein Castle
prompt: Describe the historical significance of Posterstein Castle and its role in the region.
hint: Focus on the castle's origins, its strategic importance, and key historical events associated with it.
sample: Posterstein Castle, built in the Middle Ages, served as a seat of power and an administrative center. It was strategically important for controlling the region and suppressing Slavic influences.

title: Architectural Features of Posterstein Castle
prompt: Explain the architectural evolution of Posterstein Castle from the Middle Ages to the Renaissance.
hint: Mention the original fortification, later expansions, and distinctive Renaissance elements like the arch and plastered facade.
sample: Originally a ring fort with a central keep, Posterstein Castle was expanded in the Renaissance style, adding a Zwinger and a distinctive arch resting on vaulted consoles.

title: Defensive Features and Military Role
prompt: Describe the defensive features of Posterstein Castle and how it was used during attacks.
hint: Include details about the keep, thick walls, entrance position, battlements, loopholes, and defensive tactics.
sample: The castle's keep had three-meter-thick walls and a high entrance accessible possibly only by rope ladder. Defenders used battlements and loopholes to fire arrows and dropped stones on attackers.

title: The Fluke Family and Regional Influence
prompt: Summarize the role of the Fluke family in the history of Posterstein Castle and the region.
hint: Discuss their acquisition of the castle, expansion of influence, and notable family members.
